description:
Put a file on a computer: either a local file, or text you write (a script, a config file, a list). When connected to a host that authorizes file reads, its path permission decision applies to library_path. Standalone clients require the file inside the Library (MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH).

WHEN TO USE:
- A command or website on the computer needs one of the person's files: pass library_path.
- You need to write a file on the computer: pass content. This is easier than writing it through computer_run, with no quoting.

GOOD TO KNOW: one file at a time, up to 200 MB (zip a folder first). By default it won't overwrite a file on the computer; pass replace: true to overwrite.

RETURNS: the path it landed at on the computer and its size.

computer.description: The computer's name, as computer_list shows it (for example "research").

content.description: Text to write into the file instead of copying a Library file.

destination.description: Where to put it on the computer; relative paths start in its home folder (for example "q3.xlsx" or "data/q3.xlsx").

library_path.description: A local file to copy. Relative paths start in the Library (for example "Reports/q3.xlsx"). When connected to a host that authorizes file reads, its path permission decision applies; standalone clients require the file inside the Library (MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH). Give this or content.

replace.description: true to overwrite an existing file there.

name: computer_copy_in
